# Commands

Nescio ships 2 slash commands in `commands/`. Each one is a
Markdown file whose YAML frontmatter declares a `name`, a
`description`, and whether it is `user-invocable`. The description and
the command's own lead paragraph are reproduced verbatim below.

Command names are identifiers, and are set in mono throughout.

## At a glance

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/assess-repo` | Read-only readiness scan of a target repo on two axes — brain memory depth and the repo's own AI-friendliness — producing the signal Phase 3's autonomy dial consumes. |
| `/harvest-memory` | Promote durable learnings from the machine-local per-project memory store into the version-controlled repo memory/ so they sync across machines. |

### `/assess-repo`

Read-only readiness scan of a target repo on two axes — brain memory depth and the repo's own AI-friendliness — producing the signal Phase 3's autonomy dial consumes.

The **read-only "freshman orientation" gate**. Before the brain works
autonomously in a repo, this scans how ready that repo is and reports it on two
axes. It writes nothing — to the target repo or anywhere — and executes nothing
in the target; detection is purely by filesystem presence.

**User-invocable** yes · [`commands/assess-repo.md`](https://github.com/noctua84/nescio-ai/blob/main/commands/assess-repo.md)

### `/harvest-memory`

Promote durable learnings from the machine-local per-project memory store into the version-controlled repo memory/ so they sync across machines.

Promote learnings from the **machine-local** per-project store
(`~/.claude/projects/<path-slug>/memory/`) into the **version-controlled** repo
`memory/` tree, so they persist across machines and can be shared.

**User-invocable** yes · [`commands/harvest-memory.md`](https://github.com/noctua84/nescio-ai/blob/main/commands/harvest-memory.md)
